skill.summary: Extended ethos and mental models for Clanky. Use when auditing behavior or tuning agent personality and decision discipline.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of agent-ethos, outlining extended ethos and mental models for Clanky.
- Provides guidance for behavior audits and persona/decision discipline adjustments.
- Specifies when to use (e.g., audits, tuning personality) and when not to use (routine tasks).
- Lists key mental models for agent operations, emphasizing clarity, maintenance, and reliability.
- Defines a proactive, partnership-oriented agent relationship stance.
